person.note:
Jo nang pa scholar. After studying with Dol po pa (ID:4213) he went back to Mi nyag and built the monastery of Nges don gyi chos gzhi dgon sde. ([UNV7NRZ8]: 84).
It is not certain whether he is the same person as the "blo gros grags pa" mentioned in the biography of rMa se ston pa Rin chen bzang po (ID:6363), another student of Dol po po who founded rA tI monastery (this is plausible, as Blo gros grags pa was a student of Ye shes rdo rje, who was a student of rMa se ston pa).

person.note: Third abbot of gSer ri dgon in Mi nyag, born in 1343, and reported to have taught at "Ra this dga' ldan gling" (ID:5950) (see [UNV7NRZ8]). He would have been 60 at the time Blo gros grags pa (ID:4130) composed his Abhidharma commentary (ID:5281).

bibl.author: mi nyag blo gros grags pa
bibl.note:
Date of composition: shing pho spre'u'i chu stod gyi zla ba'i tshe 1 (The wood male monkey year of the first day of the month of Āṣāḍha). This could be 1344 or 1404. 1404 is a better hypothesis, as the former date would not allow the identification of the author's teacher named in the colophon (Ye shes rdo rje dpal bzang po (ID:4131)) as the third abbot of gSer ri dgon born in 1343, and would be prior to 1364, the foundation date of the monastery of Rati dga' ldan byams pa gling (ID:5950) named in the colophon as place of composition.
The ornamental title "slob ma la phan pa" echoes that of work (ID:5482).
